# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

Cyber Security Agency Australia (CSA) is committed to a professional, respectful, and safe collaboration environment for all contributors and stakeholders.

## Expected Behaviour

- Be respectful, constructive, and professional in all interactions.
- Focus discussions on evidence, impact, and institutional outcomes.
- Accept feedback and resolve disagreements in good faith.
- Protect confidential, controlled, and security-sensitive information.

## Unacceptable Behaviour

- Harassment, discrimination, intimidation, or abusive language.
- Deliberate misinformation or unsupported institutional claims.
- Sharing confidential data, credentials, or sensitive material.
- Disruptive conduct that blocks constructive collaboration.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove, edit, or reject contributions and interactions that violate this Code of Conduct.

## Reporting

Report Code of Conduct concerns to: info@cs-agency.com.au  
For security incidents, use: security@cs-agency.com.au
